findings.reason: The upper-cut embedding preserves the alphabet-supported monomial label, while the lower-cut embedding changes every column height and appends a common entry. Two concrete compatibility squares materially distinguish these maps and explain why a cut-independent bar exists. This is a warranted explanatory addition under the expanded scope, not an allegation of a broken existing formula or an incomplete proof.

diagram_math_checks.result: F_{k,r} denotes the finite-cut realization on [k,r], not a new fixed-degree module. For admissible R>r, j_{r,R}:F_{k,r}→F_{k,R} sends M_A to M_A, keeping column heights and labels. Injectivity follows from distinct monomials remaining distinct; both horizontal hooks have exactly these endpoints. This matches Statement (3), proof step 3.2 and monomial-basis supplier Statement (2)–(3).

iota_k:F_{k,r}→F_{k-1,r} sends M_A to M_{A sqcup (k-1)^l}. There are l columns, each gains one bottom entry k-1; since old entries lie in [k,r], no duplicate is created and decreasing top-to-bottom order is preserved. Removing the common appended bottom entry recovers A, establishing the depicted hook. This is monomial-basis supplier step 5.1 and the Fock definition column convention/verification step 2.1.

Both paths F_{k,r}→F_{k,R} are psi_{k,R} composed with j_{r,R} and j_{r,R} composed with psi_{k,r}. Their equality is precisely local proof step 3.2: old-root quasi-R terms agree, new upper-boundary terms kill the supported prefix. Vertical maps are endomorphisms of the respective underlying additive groups, semilinear under s→s^{-1} rather than linear quantum-module arrows.

Both paths F_{k,r}→F_{k-1,r} are psi_{k-1,r} composed with iota_k and iota_k composed with psi_{k,r}. Local proof step 4.1 proves equality: every new-boundary positive word encounters the occupied k-1 position and vanishes, and the old-root tail weights are zero. The illustration does not claim that every new generator vanishes on the image.

For the canonical eta_{k,r}:F_{k,r}→F(Lambda), the written relation psi eta_{k,r}=eta_{k,r} psi_{k,r} is the compatible-family construction in local step 5.1. Steps 3.2 and 4.1 give independence of either cut enlargement; the monomial-basis supplier step 6.1 identifies the limit including semi-infinite columns. Charts/bases are only restated from Statement (3)/step 4.1, with no new raw-tensor basedness claim. All original proof steps remain unchanged and do not use either diagram.
